achievements.name: Yuna's Guardian
achievements.detail: Join Yuna as a guardian on her pilgrimage.

achievements.name: Valefor
achievements.detail: Clear the Cloister of Trials in Besaid Temple and obtain the aeon Valefor.

achievements.name: Jecht Shot
achievements.detail: Learn the Jecht Shot on the voyage to Luca.

achievements.name: Luca Goers
achievements.detail: Win the blitzball match against the Luca Goers.

achievements.name: Anima
achievements.detail: Gather the hidden Cloister treasures and obtain the aeon Anima at Baaj Temple.

achievements.name: Celestial Weapon
achievements.detail: Upgrade a Celestial Weapon with its crest and sigil.

achievements.name: Penance
achievements.detail: Defeat Penance after it appears over the Calm Lands.

achievements.name: Pilgrimage's End
achievements.detail: Finish Yuna's pilgrimage and complete Final Fantasy X.

achievements.name: Gullwings
achievements.detail: Clear the opening mission in Luca with the Gullwings in Final Fantasy X-2.

achievements.name: Dressphere
achievements.detail: Switch dresspheres during a battle and win it.

achievements.name: Episode Complete
achievements.detail: In Chapter 5 of Final Fantasy X-2, settle an area so the result reads Episode Complete.

achievements.name: All Dresspheres
achievements.detail: Collect every dressphere in Final Fantasy X-2.

achievements.name: Last Mission
achievements.detail: Clear Last Mission, the bonus episode included with the remaster.

achievements.name: Full Completion
achievements.detail: See the Final Fantasy X-2 ending that requires one hundred percent completion.
